Hey PH, Agent orchestration is one of the most powerful things in AI right now and until today, only engineers could actually use it. 2 19 p/mindra Zeynep Yorulmaz • 7d ago Excited for May 4th Hey, Really excited to show what we have built at Mindra. 0 7 View all Social X ElevenAgents by ElevenLabs — Scale conversations without scaling your team Scale conversations without scaling your team Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Zeynep Yorulmaz Mindra Maker 📌 Hey Product Hunt 👋. I’m Zeynep, co-founder of Mindra. We started building Mindra with my co-founders @denizsoylular and @ilker_yoru 6 months ago. The problem AI agents are powerful, but isolated. Each does one thing, none collaborate, and when one fails, the whole workflow breaks. Most tools fall into two dead ends: • Single-agent assistants → great at drafting, not at doing. A summary isn’t a shipped campaign. • Pre-defined chains (Zapier, n8n, LangChain) → look clean on a whiteboard, but in production every step is a fragile point of failure. No critic, no retry, no fallback. What we built instead Mindra runs teams of specialized AI agents that actually execute work across your tools—with humans in the loop where it matters, and tight permissions everywhere else. Why it’s different • Teams, not chain

Readers can discover, buy, download, and read comics without platform lock-in. Creators and publishers keep 80%, stay non-exclusive, and get access to an audience already reading comics every day. Try AppSignal Promoted Readwise Resurfacing your best highlights from Kindle, iBooks & more 4.8 ( 19 reviews ) Note and writing apps Email marketing Hardcover Social discovery for serious book lovers 4.8 ( 15 reviews ) Social & Community Social Networking Reedsy Where beautiful books are made 4.8 ( 127 reviews ) Community management Books Veve Comics An exciting new way to read and collect comic books NFT marketplaces Marketplace sites Literal Track your reading and discover your next favourite book 4.5 ( 8 reviews ) Social Networking Activity tracking View more Subscribe Sign in Social X Kinetik — AI agent to rule them all: content, ops, growth AI agent to rule them all: content, ops, growth Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Victor Baro Storybeat Maker 📌 Hey Product Hunt 👋 I’m Victor, co-founder of Panels. For the last 8 years, we’ve been building Panels as a DRM-free comic reader for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. The app has grown in popularity, but there was always one big problem: Panels was a great place to read comics, but not a great place to discover or buy them. Readers had to find DRM-free comics somewhere else, download them, import them, and then read them in Panels. That worked for power users, but it created friction for everyone else. It also meant we were helping people read comics without doing enough to directly support the creators making them. So we built Panels Store - available via the web and inside the Panels app. Panels Store is a DRM-free marketplace for digital comics, connected to the reader people already use. For readers: • Buy comics without DRM • Download your files or stream them to read directly in Panels(no need to download full files) • Keep access to your library without being locked into a closed platform For creators and publishers: • Keep 80% of every sale • No exclusivity • No DRM • No technical setup required • Reach an audience tha
